benefits.name: Marriott Bonvoy Gold Elite Status
benefits.description: Complimentary Marriott Bonvoy Gold Elite status, including a 25% points bonus on stays and 2 p.m. late checkout when available.
benefits.terms: Automatic with cardmembership by linking a Marriott Bonvoy account.

benefits.name: Annual Elite Night Credits
benefits.description: 15 Elite Night Credits toward Marriott Bonvoy elite status tiers each calendar year.
benefits.terms: Stackable with Elite Night Credits from a personal Marriott Bonvoy card toward status advancement.

benefits.name: Anniversary Free Night Award
benefits.description: One Free Night Award every year after the card renewal month, redeemable for a night at a Marriott Bonvoy property with a redemption level at or under 35,000 points.
benefits.terms: Can be topped up with up to 25,000 of the cardholder's own points for a higher-category redemption. Expires one year from issuance.

benefits.name: Additional Free Night Award (Spend Threshold)
benefits.description: A second Free Night Award, redeemable for a night at a Marriott Bonvoy property with a redemption level at or under 35,000 points, after spending $60,000 on the card in a calendar year.
benefits.terms: Requires $60,000 in eligible purchases within the calendar year.

benefits.name: 7% Room Rate Discount
benefits.description: 7% discount on standard flexible room rates when booking directly with Marriott through an eligible channel.
benefits.terms: Requires both Marriott Bonvoy membership and Marriott Bonvoy Business card membership; applies to eligible direct bookings only.

earningRates.terms: Restaurants worldwide, U.S. gas stations, wireless telephone services purchased directly from U.S. service providers, and U.S. purchases for shipping.
